As an Assembly Operator in mechanical engineering, you work independently on complex high-tech machines. From robots to transport systems: technical and varied. Wie zoeken we? You'll have plenty of freedom to apply your technical expertise broadly as an Assembly Operator. One moment you're working on a larger machine construction, the next on a robot, conveyor, or mechatronic module. With multiple assembly departments, you can continue to vary your work and develop yourself technically. Opportunity to develop your skills more broadly by gaining experience across different assembly departments and techniques. Functieomschrijving You'll join an international machinery manufacturer in Lichtenvoorde where high-quality machines for the food processing industry are developed and built. Within assembly, different teams work closely together. Craftsmanship and quality are central, but sharing knowledge and solving technical problemstogether are also part of how we work. As an Assembly Operator in machinery manufacturing, you'll have considerable independence in assembling, inspecting, adjusting and testing machines and modules. The work ranges from large constructions to smaller mechatronic modules. Depending on the project, you might work on robotic solutions, conveyors or service and overhaul work. This variety ensures that even experienced machinery manufacturers remain technically challenged. Independently assemble modules and complete machines. Mount mechanical and mechatronic components. Work on larger machine constructions, robots and transport systems. Read and apply technical drawings. Perform inspections, adjustments and functional tests. Ensure quality of your own work. Identify and resolve technical deviations. Collaborate with engineering and other production departments. Contribute ideas on feasibility and improvements in the assembly process.
